items.title: Nightmare Bonnie
items.summary: Nightmare Bonnie is a major antagonist and one of the nightmare animatronics of the Five Nights at Freddy's series, first appearing in Five Nights at Freddy's 4.  He is a nightmarish variant of Bonnie the Rabbit.

items.title: Youtooz Collectibles
items.summary: Youtooz Collectibles are collectible figures, plushies, pins, and more based on the Five Nights at Freddy's characters by Youtooz Inc.  Each figure is around 4-5 inches tall.
